guidance: Heavy means the main resistance session, not maximal lifting: progress to the single-leg variations listed and load them with your two dumbbells (up to 5 kg each) or a kettlebell you can control. Work close to the limit of good form - finish the last set of each exercise with 1-2 reps in reserve, never to failure. If an exercise is new, drop a set and halve the load for the first two weeks. Hop and skip finishers are small and springy; skip them if calves or tendons are sore. Train after the easy run or separate by several hours. Light sessions are bodyweight, controlled effort, and should not compromise the next run. Most sessions take 15-45 min; never exceed 1 hour. Stop for sharp pain, dizziness or unusual symptoms; get technique help if unsure.
mobility: 15 min gentle mobility only: 3 min easy walking, 2 min ankle circles and ankle rocks, 3 min gentle hip rotations, 3 min cat-cow and upper-back rotations, 4 min relaxed calf/hip-flexor stretches (20-30 s per side). Stay within a comfortable range; no loaded strength, heavy leg work or deep stretching.

routines.title: Heavy 1: runner foundations
exercises: Warm-up: 5 min easy walking or marching, then 8 bodyweight squats and 8 unloaded hip hinges.
Weighted single-leg calf raises: 3 sets x 12 reps per side, dumbbell in one hand. Rise smoothly and lower for 3 seconds. Rest 30 s between sides and 60 s between sets.

Rear-foot-elevated split squat: 3 sets x 8 reps per side with both dumbbells, rear foot on a low step; lower for 3 seconds. Rest 30 s between sides and 75 s between sets. Alternative: 3 x 8 weighted step-ups per side onto a higher stable step; do not do both.
Single-leg bridge: 3 sets x 10 reps per side, pause 2 seconds at the top with hips level. Rest 30 s between sides and 60 s between sets.
Romanian deadlifts: 3 sets x 10 reps with both dumbbells; hinge at the hips, lower for 4 seconds and leave 1-2 reps in reserve on the final set. Rest 90 s between sets.
Pogo hops: 2 sets x 15 low, springy hops on the spot; quiet contacts, stay tall. Rest 60 s between sets.
Rest 60-90 s when changing exercises. Finish with 2-3 min easy walking. Allow about 40-50 min; drop a set from each exercise if it compromises Thursday running.

routines.title: Light 1: core control and hip mobility
exercises: Warm-up: 2 min relaxed walking or marching.
Dead bug: 2 sets x 8 slow reps per side, reaching the arm and leg long and hovering the heel just off the floor; exhale as you extend. Rest 30 s between sets.
Bird dog: 2 sets x 8 reps per side, holding each rep for 5 seconds. Keep hips level. Rest 30 s between sets.
Side-lying clamshells: 2 sets x 12 reps per side with a 2-second hold at the top, no band or weights. Rest 15 s between sides and 30 s between sets.
Mobility: 6 ankle rocks per side, 6 gentle cat-cow reps, then comfortable hip-flexor and calf stretches, 20 s per side, one round.

Rest 30 s when changing exercises. About 20-25 min total. No heavy leg work, loaded squats, deadlifts or work to fatigue. If also doing Pilates, do one set or mobility only rather than doubling the workload.

routines.title: Heavy 2: step-up and hinge control
exercises: Warm-up: 5 min walking, then 8 ankle rocks and 8 unloaded hip hinges.
Lateral step-up: 3 sets x 8 reps per side with both dumbbells; step down slowly over 3 seconds. Rest 30 s between sides and 75 s between sets.
Kickstand Romanian deadlifts: 3 sets x 8 reps per side with both dumbbells, 4-second lowering; back toes support balance. Rest 30 s between sides and 90 s between sets.
Glute bridges: 3 sets x 12 reps with a dumbbell resting on your hips and a 3-second hold at the top. Rest 60 s between sets.
Single-leg calf isometric hold: 3 sets x 20 s per side with the knee straight, standing tall. Rest 20 s between sides and 60 s between sets.
Skipping in place: 2 sets x 20 s of light, bouncy skips with quiet landings. Rest 60 s between sets.
Rest 60-90 s between exercises. Cool down with 2 min walking. About 40-50 min.

routines.title: Light 2: side-body stability and ankles
exercises: Warm-up: 2 min easy marching.
Side plank: 2 sets x 20-30 s per side from the feet; drop to the knees only if form slips, and breathe normally. Rest 15 s between sides and 30 s between sets.
Standing supported balance: 2 sets x 30 s per side, closing your eyes for the second set if steady; keep fingertips near a support. Rest 15 s between sides and 30 s between sets.
Side-lying leg raises: 2 sets x 12 reps per side with a 2-second hold at the top. Rest 15 s between sides and 30 s between sets.
Ankle rocks: 2 sets x 10 reps per side. Rest 20 s between sets. Finish with calf and hip-flexor stretches, 20 s per side.
Bodyweight only; rest 30 s between exercises. About 20-25 min. No heavy leg work. With Pilates, use one set or mobility only.

routines.title: Heavy 3: split squat and bridge strength
exercises: Warm-up: 5 min walking, 8 bodyweight squats and 8 unloaded hinges.

Supported split squats: 3 sets x 10 reps per side with both dumbbells and a 2-second pause at the bottom; on the final set use 1.5 reps (lower, rise halfway, lower again, stand). Rest 30 s between sides and 75 s between sets.
Romanian deadlifts: 3 sets x 8 reps with both dumbbells; pause 2 seconds at the bottom and lower for 4 seconds. Rest 90 s between sets.
Single-leg heel-dig bridge: 3 sets x 8 reps per side with a 2-second pause at the top. Rest 30 s between sides and 60 s between sets.
Weighted single-leg calf raises: 3 sets x 12 reps per side with a dumbbell, pause 1 second at the top. Rest 30 s between sides and 60 s between sets.
Pogo hops: 2 sets x 15 low, springy hops; land quietly and stay tall. Rest 60 s between sets.
Rest 60-90 s between exercises. Cool down with 2 min walking. About 40-50 min.

routines.title: Light 3: recovery mobility flow
exercises: Warm-up: 3 min easy walking.
Cat-cow: 2 sets x 6 gentle reps. Rest 20 s between sets.
Open-book upper-back rotations: 2 sets x 6 reps per side, comfortable range. Rest 15 s between sides and 20 s between sets.
Seated hip rotations: 2 sets x 6 reps per side, use hands for support. Rest 20 s between sets.
Ankle circles: 2 sets x 8 each direction per ankle. Rest 15 s between sets. Finish with gentle calf and hip-flexor stretches, 20 s per side.
Move slowly, never force a stretch. Rest 20-30 s between exercises. About 15 min. No heavy leg work. With Pilates, use one round only.

routines.title: Heavy 4: controlled squat and posterior chain
exercises: Warm-up: 5 min walking, 8 bodyweight sit-to-stands and 8 unloaded hinges.
Goblet squat: 3 sets x 10 reps holding your heaviest dumbbell close to your chest; 3-second lowering, standing tall without a chair. Rest 75 s between sets.
Supported reverse lunge: 3 sets x 8 reps per side with both dumbbells; keep the front heel planted. Rest 30 s between sides and 75 s between sets.
Romanian deadlifts: 3 sets x 10 reps, 4-second lowering, leaving 1-2 reps in reserve on the final set. Rest 90 s between sets.
Staggered-stance bridges: 3 sets x 12 reps per side with a 2-second pause at the top. Rest 30 s between sides and 60 s between sets.
Weighted single-leg calf raises: 3 sets x 10 reps per side, dumbbell in one hand. Rest 30 s between sides and 60 s between sets.
Skipping in place: 2 sets x 20 s of light, springy skips. Rest 60 s between sets.
Rest 60-90 s between exercises. Cool down with 2 min walking. About 45-55 min; drop a set from each exercise if recovery suffers.

routines.title: Light 4: gentle trunk and hip activation
exercises: Warm-up: 2 min relaxed walking.
Dead-bug heel taps: 2 sets x 8 reps per side with a slow 3-second lowering. Rest 30 s between sets.
Quadruped arm reaches: 2 sets x 8 reps per side with a 3-second hold, keeping your back still. Rest 30 s between sets.
Bridge march: 2 sets x 6 lifts per side from a low bridge, keeping the pelvis level. Rest 30 s between sets.
Standing hip circles holding a support: 2 sets x 6 each direction per side. Rest 20 s between sets. Finish with 6 ankle rocks per side.
Rest 30 s between exercises. About 15-20 min, easy effort. No heavy leg work. With Pilates, use one set or mobility only.

routines.title: Heavy 5: low-step single-leg stability
exercises: Warm-up: 5 min walking, 8 unloaded hinges and 8 ankle rocks per side.
Controlled forward step-down: 3 sets x 8 reps per side with a 3-second lowering from a higher step; use support only for balance. Rest 30 s between sides and 75 s between sets.
Supported single-leg deadlift: 3 sets x 10 reps per side with a dumbbell in the free hand, hips square. Rest 30 s between sides and 90 s between sets.
Single-leg chair rise: 3 sets x 6 slow reps per side; tap the chair without sitting, fingertip support if needed. Rest 30 s between sides and 75 s between sets.
Weighted single-leg calf raises: 3 sets x 12 reps per side, smooth movement with a dumbbell. Rest 30 s between sides and 60 s between sets.
Pogo hops: 2 sets x 15 low, springy hops on the spot. Rest 60 s between sets.
Rest 60-90 s between exercises. Cool down with 2 min walking. About 40-50 min.

routines.title: Light 5: pre-long-run reset
exercises: Warm-up: 3 min relaxed walking.
Standing supported balance: 2 sets x 30 s per side, no weights; try the second set with eyes closed if steady. Rest 15 s between sides and 30 s between sets.
Bird dog: 2 sets x 6 reps per side with a 3-second hold. Rest 30 s between sets.
Supine pelvic tilts: 2 sets x 10 gentle reps. Rest 20 s between sets.
Mobility: 6 ankle rocks per side, 6 cat-cow reps, then gentle calf and hip-flexor stretches for 20 s per side, one round.
Rest 20-30 s between exercises. About 15 min. Finish fresher than you started. No heavy leg work. With Pilates, use one set or mobility only.
